svg.title: Numbered clears per move by occupancy band — the attracting equilibrium versus the death spiral
svg.desc: Numbered clears per move by occupancy band — the attracting equilibrium versus the death spiral. From finding-06 section 3's occupancy-conditional table. Bands are 0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49 occupied cells; x positions are band midpoints chosen for drawing (the bands are the recorded unit). Bands are not matched samples across policies; each point carries its recorded move count n, and sparse cells should not be over-read. rh-clears cap-1000 bands above 34 cells and the rh-points 45-49 band are em-dashes in the source table (not recorded) — those points are omitted. The flat series is the exact disc-conservation requirement 2.400 = 12/5 (finding-01); the generator has no reference-line primitive, so it is drawn as a two-point polyline. rh-clears is a clairvoyant (privileged) diagnostic, not a legal policy. Evidence tier: exploratory mechanism study. Sources: docs/exploratory/finding-06-flow-ceiling.md, docs/exploratory/finding-01-score-is-survival.md.
